contract: Master Services Agreement - Northwind Cloud Platform

clauses.text: No discount is automatic. Any discount greater than ten percent (10%) requires prior written approval from the VP of Sales, and every discount actually granted must be listed on the signed Order Form. Verbal discount commitments are not binding.
Support under the Standard Plan is available 9:00 to 17:00 local time, Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. 24/7 support is available only under the Enterprise Plan.
Customer data is stored in the region selected at signup and is not transferred to another region without Customer's prior written consent.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience with thirty (30) days written notice. Termination does not entitle Customer to a refund of prepaid fees for the remainder of the term.

The service targets 99.5% monthly uptime on the Standard Plan and 99.9% monthly uptime on the Enterprise Plan. Service credits for missed targets are capped at fifteen percent (15%) of monthly fees. Uptime commitments above the plan target are not made.
